responsibility: Configures the rs6000 target defaults for Xilinx embedded PowerPC board environments. It overrides the preprocessor spec to define Xilinx FPU feature macros from mfpu settings, changes default library grouping and optional performance-library selection, selects Xilinx-specific startup objects, and forces the default linker script, so the GCC driver emits the runtime and link configuration expected by Xilinx standalone embedded systems.
same_name_distinction: Unlike xilinx.opt, this header applies the Xilinx embedded target policy by rewriting driver specs such as CPP_SPEC, library selection, startup files, and linker script defaults; it consumes options rather than declaring them.
